note: Small wooded campground on the Bearcamp River in South Tamworth, with a walking trail along the river, a pool and a playground. Nightly, weekly, monthly and seasonal sites. Owned by the same family since 2019. --Claude
summary: Operator page + map + Google: full hookups 20/30/50 A at $47 (under the $50 gate), partial $30 for tents/vans/pop-ups, pull-throughs 7, 8, 25-31, free hot showers, WiFi, phone booking, veterans discount. Google 4.7 (51 reviews). Sells nightly openly; seasonal share not stated. Not waterfront (river behind forest). Season not published.
flags: Private park: Google Maps 4.7 stars, 51 reviews. Price $47 a night full hookup (cheapest RV night any season; the page gives one rate, so the summer peak is also $47), under the $50 gate. No Good Sam listing change (stored false kept).

Long-stay tests: pass. The home page leads with nightly and weekly rates and 'Call us today for site availability'; monthly and seasonal sites exist ('Seasonal Sites Rates vary'). Nightly share not stated; imagery shows ~15 rigs on ~35 sites, without decks or sheds that mark a seasonal-dominated park. No minimum stay, no age rule.

Waterfront: not waterfront stays. The Bearcamp River runs along the north/east edge behind ~50-80 m of forest on Esri imagery; the map's walking trail runs between the sites and the river (sites 35-38 and tent sites 1-3 nearest).
Season: the operator's page gives no open/close dates; the stored mid-May to mid-October (derived, approximate) is left as is and is unconfirmed.
Map shows two 'Future Campsites' areas; site count not written (map numbers run to 38 with gaps, plus 3 tent sites).
camp_store (stored true) is not mentioned on the page; left unchanged.
Pin 43.82835,-71.32793 is at the entrance off the road, ~150 m east of the loops; under 250 m, no move.
